main_issue: Who completes Agent D's unfinished section before Thursday: Agent A alone covering it, or Agent D working on it tonight after the wake

A-B.evidence: B challenges A's plan (T13, T15, T18) and says 'You don't get to just decide that for everyone' (T24); A insists 'My decision stands' (T23).

A-C.evidence: C suggests D work tonight (T19); A: 'No... I've already made the decision' (T20); C: 'This isn't just your decision' (T21); A closes discussion (T23).

A-D.evidence: D offers to work tonight (T4, T9, T11, T22); A refuses each time and says 'that is not the safest way... This discussion is over' (T23).

B-C.evidence: C backs B's quality concern: 'She has a point' (T16), 'She's right' (T19); both oppose A's unilateral decision (T21, T24).

B-D.evidence: B opposes A solo plan and wants a workable plan; D (T22) says 'they have a point'; B does not explicitly endorse D working tonight, but is aligned against A.

C-D.evidence: C proposes 'Agent D said she could work tonight... let her do what she can' (T19); D agrees 'they have a point... Let me do it' (T22).
